action.content:
import csv
import io

def write_csv(rows, fieldnames):
    output = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=fieldnames, lineterminator='\n')
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return output.getvalue()
